ModMetaData.name: RimMcp - Claude bridge
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description:
Lets an AI assistant (Claude Code, or any MCP client) read your colony and give simple orders while you play.
The mod opens a local-only endpoint (127.0.0.1, token-protected) and the bundled MCP server (Mcp/rimmcp_server.py) turns it into tools: colony status, colonists, resources, alerts, threats, game speed, drafting, work priorities, in-game messages and camera focus.
Nothing leaves your computer unless your MCP client sends it.
